name: GableScope
tagline: Fly the roof, file the report, get paid — before you climb down the ladder.
positioning: GableScope turns a 12-minute drone flight into a client-ready inspection report, so owner-operators stop losing evenings to photo sorting and PDFs.

hero.h1: Land the drone. The report is already done.
hero.sub: GableScope stitches your flight footage into a measured, annotated inspection report while you pack up the gear. Built for the one-truck operator, not the enterprise procurement team.

features.title: Report in the truck
features.description: Upload footage from the job site and GableScope drafts a client-ready PDF with cover photo, findings list, and your logo in under four minutes.

features.title: Measured damage, not guesses
features.description: Tap a cracked shingle or lifted flashing and get square-footage and pitch estimates pulled straight from the flight path.

features.title: Part 107 log that keeps itself
features.description: Every flight auto-records date, location, aircraft, and airspace so your FAA logbook is audit-ready without a spreadsheet.

features.title: Annotate with your thumb
features.description: Circle the problem, drop a note, mark it urgent. Homeowners and adjusters see exactly what you saw, no jargon required.

features.title: One link to the customer
features.description: Send a live report link instead of a 40MB email. They view findings on their phone and approve the estimate in a tap.

features.title: Every roof, one shelf
features.description: Search past inspections by address, client, or date. Re-inspection quotes take seconds when the history is already there.

testimonials.quote: I used to spend Sunday nights renaming photos and copy-pasting into Word. Now I hand the customer a report before I'm off the roof. It paid for itself in the first storm week.
testimonials.name: Marcus Deel

testimonials.quote: Adjusters stopped kicking my claims back. The measured findings and the flight log in one PDF meant I stopped arguing about whether I even flew the property.
testimonials.name: Priya Nair

testimonials.quote: We run three drone crews now and GableScope keeps every seat's logbook straight. I added my second pilot on a Tuesday and he was billing reports by Thursday.
testimonials.name: Danny Osei

pricing.blurb: For the owner-operator flying their own jobs.
For the small firm running a few pilots and a lot of roofs.
For multi-crew operations that need admin control.

homepage.footerBlurb: GableScope is inspection software for the people actually flying the drone. Fewer late nights, cleaner reports, faster invoices.
